title: gosaml2 malformed encrypted assertions can panic before validation
summary: An AES-GCM CipherValue shorter than the nonce size causes an unchecked slice operation. A crafted SAML response can trigger the panic before signature or content validation completes.

severity.rationale: Unauthenticated input can cause a panic in a security dependency. The documented impact is denial of service, not authentication bypass or code execution.

exposure: The service provider must parse the crafted encrypted assertion. No valid SAML signature is required.

params.instructions: Check github.com/russellhaering/gosaml2 version and the documented exposure conditions against the cited advisory.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
